meta.title: Alexis Sanchis — Software Engineer
meta.description: Software engineer based in France. Next.js, Nest.js, TypeScript and Python. Available for new opportunities.

hero.name: Alexis Sanchis
hero.summary: French–Swiss software engineer, building web and mobile applications since 2017, largely for the healthcare sector. Currently at Elipce Solutions, working mainly with React, Next.js and TypeScript. I hold a French RNCP certification in cybersecurity and apply OWASP practices to the work I ship. I care about clear communication, maintainable code, and work a team can build on.

items.description: Custom web and mobile applications for a range of clients, across the full project lifecycle. React, Ionic and TypeScript on the front end; Laravel and Django on the back.
Opaline Santé, a home-care booking platform serving over 80,000 users, built with Next.js and Symfony. Also maintained the shared UI component library alongside the design team.

Android applications for home nursing and care homes, designed to work offline in low-coverage environments through an embedded SQLite database and background synchronisation. Java and Kotlin, later migrated to Flutter.
Cross-platform augmented-reality application in Unity, displaying geolocated points of interest in real time, with a native Swift layer for iPad.
